name: ioda-outages-mcp-server
description: Investigate Internet outages with IODA events, alerts, and connectivity signals via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate Internet outages with IODA events, alerts, and connectivity signals via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Resolve countries, regions, and autonomous systems, inspect recent IODA detection evidence, and retrieve outage events, alert transitions, and numeric BGP, active-probing, and Merit telescope observations. Rank the countries, regions, or networks hit hardest in a window with IODA's own outage-summary scores. Source attribution, missing samples, clipped event boundaries, and partial failures remain explicit. Measurement coverage and returned detections support macroscopic Internet investigations; they do not establish an all-clear, a shutdown cause, or one office's connectivity.
